body_text:
For a subspace $U\leq V$, its annihilator is
$U^\circ=\{\lambda\in V^*: \lambda(u)=0\text{ for every }
u\in U\}$. When $V$ is finite-dimensional,
$\dim U+\dim U^\circ=\dim V$. Annihilators translate
containment into reverse containment: if $U\subseteq W$, then
$W^\circ\subseteq U^\circ$.
